# BioGPT Lit

BioGPT Lit: 

BioGPT Lit can be transformed into a continuously evolving, self-indexing scientific reasoning engine that goes far beyond retrieval and summarization to construct a living, multi-layered representation of biological knowledge.

evidence_and_limit: Manual graph plus PubMed adapter, no continuous self-indexing service verified.

text: At the ingestion layer, the system parses full-text papers, supplementary datasets, figures, and experimental methods, extracting not only entities such as genes, proteins, pathways, and compounds, but also directionally encoded relationships—activation, inhibition, binding affinity shifts, causal disease associations, and experimental conditions.

text: These relationships are embedded into a dynamic, temporally-aware knowledge graph where each edge is weighted by evidence strength, reproducibility signals, citation propagation, and methodological rigor.

evidence_and_limit: Edge weights from supplied citations/sample/replication, not independently audited evidence rigor.

text: This enables the system to distinguish between preliminary findings and well-established biological principles, allowing downstream reasoning to be grounded in the quality of evidence rather than mere frequency of mention.

text: On top of this structured graph, BioGPT Lit deploys graph neural networks and long-context transformer architectures to perform multi-hop reasoning across domains that are traditionally siloed.

text: At its core, the system ingests raw variant data (VCF-level inputs) and maps them across multiple annotation layers—genomic (ClinVar, Ensembl), population frequency (gnomAD), functional prediction (SIFT, PolyPhen, SpliceAI), and disease ontologies (HPO, OMIM).

text: These heterogeneous data streams are embedded into a unified probabilistic framework that applies ACMG/AMP guidelines not as rigid rules, but as weighted Bayesian evidence components, allowing the system to compute posterior probabilities of pathogenicity with transparent reasoning traces.
